name: Hammer Slam
description: Performs a narrow-range attack around the targets as if you are slamming them down. Guarantees a critical hit on targets immobilized by Flinch or other status ailments. MP Cost becomes 0 if used consecutively.

name: Cleaving Attack
description: Swings the sword horizontally to deal with multiple opponents. If 2 or more targets are involved, the power will increase proportionally and consumed MP will be restored.

name: Storm Blaze
description: Attacks enemies in a straight line with an aerial slash. Wind Power will accumulate when a normal attack hits. Wind Power is consumed upon skill activation. Power, attack range, and MP recovery increases according to the amount consumed.

name: Garde Blade
description: A defense technique using a two-handed sword. Boosts Physical/Magic Resistance and improves Guard ability for 70 seconds. Recovers Guard Power a bit when the buff is applied. Overwriting won't trigger this recovery.

name: Ogre Slash
description: Deals damage to the target and after a short while, causes an explosion at the target's feet, dealing additional damage. If the conditions are met, Ogre Power will be accumulated and consumed upon skill activation to increase the power and buff.

name: Hard Hit
description: Brutally hit the target with the weapon. Chance to inflict [Flinch] on the target.

name: Astute
description: Strongly hit the target in rapid motion. Critical Rate +25 when this skill is activated.

name: Trigger Slash
description: Infuses power into the sword while slashing the target. Enhances Attack MP Recovery until the next skill is activated. Using this skill will speed up motion 1 time.

name: Rampage
description: Furiously and consecutively attack a target. Greatly enhance normal attacks 10 times and a strong attack will be activated after that. Unable to use redundantly.

name: Meteor Breaker
description: Strong attack like a meteor. Chance to inflict [Dizzy] on a target and generate Area of Effect when landing. Become invincible when activating the skill.

name: Shut-Out
description: A merciless blow. If the target is afflicted by Flinch/Tumble/Stun and not bleeding, the damage dealt will increase and the target will be inflicted with [Bleed].

name: Lunar Slash
description: Slashes target and magic blade will deal additional damage after a slight delay. Magic blade may inflict [Fatigue].

name: Sonic Blade
description: Thrust enemies by quickly moving toward them. Range and Critical Rate increase as the skill levels up. Become more powerful by using it consecutively. Sonic Blade changes to Super Sonic Blade when used while its buff is active

name: Spiral Air
description: Delivers a sharp thrust that creates wind slashes. When Spiral Air hits a target, Critical Damage increases for a few seconds.

name: Sword Tempest
description: A strong slash that generates a tempest. The tempest will deal damage over time. Enemies will be sucked into it once.

name: Buster Blade
description: Add aura and slash consecutively. Weapon ATK increases for a few seconds when activating Buster Blade. Restore a small amount of HP when the buff is added. The buff is not overwritten. Buster Blade will not overwrite an existing Buster Blade buff

name: Aura Blade
description: Slashes and clears your surroundings with a blade surrounded by an aura. The power of the next skill used is 1.2x stronger. Grants Additional Melee to weapon while active.

name: Sword Mastery
description: Get better at swordsmanship. ATK of One/Two-Handed Swords increases.

name: Quick Slash
description: Shorten the Attack Intervals of One/Two-Handed Swords.

name: Sword Techniques
description: Learn the mastership of swords. The damage dealt of Blade Skill increases.

name: War Cry
description: Perform a rallying cry. Increases ATK for a while. Removes status ailment: [Fear].

name: Berserk
description: Stop thinking and wield the weapon like a berserker. Increase Normal Attack Power/Attack Speed/Critical Rate for a few seconds and greatly decrease Stability/DEF/MDEF. Rampage is not removed by status ailments while it is in effect.

name: Gladiate
description: Reduces the damage received for a certain number of times for 10 seconds. Slightly restores MP when damage is reduced. Restores 10 MP per number of damage reduction effects remaining when the time is up.

name: Swift Attack
description: Kicks while pretending to attack with a sword. This skill has "normal attack proration". MP Cost for the next skill used will be reduced when the skill reaches its maximum level.

name: Power Shot
description: Shoots the target with stronger power. The charge time reduces as the skill levels up. Chance to inflict [Tumble] on the target. Critical rate increases on Slowed targets.

name: Bullseye
description: Consecutively shoots at a point. The damage dealt increases attack by attack.

name: Arrow Rain
description: Shoots a lot of arrows to the sky. The arrows fall down at intervals and deal damage.

name: Snipe
description: Snipe a weak point. The charge time decreases as the skill levels up. Chance to inflict [Armor Break]. 100% chance to hit Blind targets.

name: Cross Fire
description: Charge Skill ( 5 Levels ). Attack toward a target and deal damage to the enemies on the straight line. Power increases as the charge level increases and add an attack. Add another attack by meeting certain conditions.

name: Piercing Shot
description: An arrow that pierces even the strongest defense. Aims and attacks in a straight line with a Charge Skill ( 5 Levels ). You can move and adjust the direction with Evasion. Each hit (except for Graze) increases its performance and slightly restores MP.

name: Vanquisher
description: Delivers a powerful blow to a small area. The power gets dispersed if there are multiple targets within the area. The closer you are to the target, the more Guard and Evasion are disregarded.

name: Twin Storm
description: Greatly enhances normal attack and also increases movement speed. Overheat stacks each time a normal attack hits, and the skill status can be removed by reactivating the skill.

name: Retrograde Shot
description: A technique of shooting enemies while moving backward. Attacks in a linear range and the target with the most HP that gets hit will be marked. If you press the button for moving forward, the skill will activate without moving backward.

name: Quick Loader
description: Increases Cross Fire's charge level by 1 when it is active and not fully charged. This skill is not overwritten.

name: Moeba Shot
description: Shoots with sticky liquid. Water element attack. Dual Element with Arrow . Chance to inflict [Slow Down] on the target and when successful, damage dealt greatly increases.

name: Paralysis Shot
description: Shoots the target with a paralysis poison. Wind element attack. Dual Element with Arrow . Chance to inflict [Paralysis] on the target and when successful, damage dealt greatly increases. Increase your Stability for a while.

name: Smoke Dust
description: An attack with a smokescreen. Dark Element attack. Dual Element with Arrow . Chance to inflict [Blind] on the target and when successful, damage dealt greatly increases. Increase accuracy rate for a while.

name: Arm Break
description: Attack a target's arm and reduce its attack power. Neutral element attack. Dual Element with Arrow . Chance to inflict [Lethargy] on the target and when successful, damage dealt greatly increases.

name: Parabola Cannon
description: Attacks by firing a projectile in a parabolic trajectory. It's an AoE attack, and the farther the projectile is from the target, the faster it travels. Low chance to inflict [Silence].

name: Spread Shot
description: Attacks using 5 skillfully controlled arrows. Chance to inflict a status ailment ( weapon element ) on the target. Each hit on the same target slightly improves its performance. You can also change the direction the arrows are fired by using the directional keys.

name: Shot Mastery
description: Gets better at using bows and bowguns. ATK of Bows and Bowguns increases.

name: Long Range
description: You become good at attacking from distance. Damage dealt from 8 meters or more away increases.

name: Quick Draw
description: Quickly prepare for the next move. Chance to restore MP a little when succeeding in attacking with a skill.

name: Decoy Shot
description: Generate a clone and make it attack. The clone attacks enemies attacking within the range. The clone's attack is normal attack but it has no Proration.

name: Element Starter
description: The element of bow or bowgun will be activated at the same time as the arrow. *Not valid for dual element skills. Gets a small recovery barrier each time you deal damage to targets with the element you are weak to.

name: Samurai Archery
description: Slightly raises ATK and stability if a bow and a katana are equipped at the same time. If a normal attack is performed with the katana, the accuracy of the next skill used increases.

name: Sneak Attack
description: Hides yourself and diverts aggro away from you. After the skill is activated, a certain number of attacks don't generate aggro.

name: Hunting Buddy
description: Summons your companion to fight alongside you. It attacks every few seconds, causing normal attack proration. The effect that enhances your companion's next attack will stack when you hit the target with a Shot Skill.

name: Fatal Shot
description: A shot skill that pierces through a strong armor. It's a unique attack with a high critical rate, but low accuracy. If it hits the target right, the tap time to break monster's part will be extended.

name: Magic: Arrows
description: Shoot small magic arrows. The arrows increase as the skill levels up.

name: Magic: Javelin
description: Drop a large magic javelin on the target. Chance to inflict a status ailment. The status ailment depends on the element. Element: [Ailment] • Neutral: [Flinch] • Fire: [Ignite] • Water: [Freeze] • Wind: [Blind] • Earth: [Slow] • Light: [Dizzy] • Dark: [Fear]

name: Magic: Lances
description: Shoot magic lances one after another. The lances increase as the skill levels up. Chance to inflict [Stop] on the target.

name: Magic: Impact
description: Attack enemies around you with a shock wave. Halves MP cost of the next skill. The effect will become weak if you consecutively use this skill.

name: Magic: Finale
description: Super wide area of effect. Deal greater damage to enemies near the center. Cast Time is long and unable to reduce it with CSPD. Generate Aggro while casting.

name: Chronos Shift
description: A forbidden technique of turning back time and deploying magic again. Instantly reactivates the last magic skill used. After using this skill, you need to wait for some time to be able to use it again.

name: Magic: Laser
description: A technique to simplify magic and release its power with the caster's ability. Power increases based on the remaining MP when activated. Low chance to inflict a status ailment ( weapon element ). After activation, your Magic Pierce slightly increases.

name: Magic: Wall
description: Create a magic wall at the feet. Deal damage and knock back enemies.

name: Magic: Blast
description: Set off a blast by concentrating magic power. Chance to inflict a status ailment. The status ailment depends on the element. Element: [Ailment] •Neutral: [Flinch] •Fire:[Ignite] •Water:[Freeze] •Wind:[Blind] •Earth:[Slow] •Light:[Dizzy] •Dark:[Fear]

name: Magic: Storm
description: A magic to generate a storm. Enemies will be sucked into it. Strong monsters may not be sucked into it.

name: Magic: Burst
description: Releases enhanced magic power. Becomes invincible as the skill activates. May Knock Back monsters except bosses. Using Magic Skills shortens its Cast Time.

name: Magic: Magic Cannon
description: A magic cannon that mows down enemies in a straight line ( Charge Skill ). Charge it to increase its power and hit count. Using a skill that involves casting will speed up the charging. When charged over 100%, it may pierce through Guard.

name: Magic: Crash
description: Summons 3 little meteorites. When hitting the target, each meteorite may drop down again up to 2 times with diminishing power, but a higher chance of inflicting [Armor Break] or [Dizzy].

name: Magic Mastery
description: Get better at using magic weapons. ATK of Staffs and Magic Devices increases.

name: Magic Knife
description: Sends out magic daggers to contain enemy. This skill has "normal attack proration". Guarantees a hit with a small amount of MP recovered. Additional attack with normal attack proration increases when it becomes Lv10.

name: Qadal
description: A forbidden technique that places a heavy burden on the mind and body. Consumes current HP and Max HP (random value) to halve the MP Cost of the next skill used and guarantee critical. If the burden gets too heavy from repeated use, then...

name: Spell Calibration
description: The ability to adjust magic to suit your needs. Allows you to adjust certain Magic Skills up to Skill Tree Lv3. *It doesn't affect Enchanted Spell.

name: MP Charge
description: Restore MP by charging magic power. The charging time reduces as the skill levels up. Unlike other skills, CSPD can only partially reduce this skill's Cast Time (up to a maximum 1 second reduction at 1000 CSPD); negative CSPD does not affect the cast time

name: Chain Cast
description: Efficiently cast magic. The cast speed of the magic skill used after "Magic: Arrows" increases. Additional effect granted with staff or magic device (main).

name: Power Wave
description: Shoot a magic wave if the target is out of range. Available from 5m or less away. The range extends up to 10m as the skill levels up. Attack MP Recovery is applied to this skill.

name: Maximizer
description: Greatly restore MP. Cast Time is shortened as the skill levels up. If you use MP Charge before this skill, the Cast Time of Maximizer will be shortened according to the skill level of MP Charge when using the skill with a Staff or Magic Device .

name: Rapid Charge
description: Slightly accelerates MP Charge. ( Up to Lv5 ). Enhances MATK and Magic Pierce ( max 50% ) that depends on MP Recovery Amount when followed by the activation of Maximizer. *Starting from Lv6, it will only extend the buff duration.

name: Enchanted Barrier
description: Creates a barrier to protect yourself. If you are inside the barrier, damage will be absorbed. Beside, you won't flinch while casting and aggro from MP consumption will be reduced. Restoring MP inside the barrier will restore the barrier's HP too.

name: Magic: Guardian Beam
description: Emits light to protect the caster. While active, magic attacks will be executed at a certain time such as after other magic skills are cast or after dealing damage to an enemy.

name: Smash
description: A powerful hit. Chance to inflict [Flinch] on the target.

name: Bash
description: Strikes a heavy blow on the head. Chance to inflict [Stun] on the target.

name: Shell Break
description: A straight punch that penetrates hard armor. The damage dealt increases as the target's DEF is higher. Low chance to inflict [Armor Break]. Recover MP if it succeeds.

name: Heavy Smash
description: A very powerful hit. Chance to inflict [Lethargy] to the target. Deal additional damage to the target that has [Armor Break].

name: Chariot
description: Shoots out the energy stored inside. Chance to inflict [Fear] to the target. Charge time is shortened depending on the skill level.

name: Abstract Arms
description: Enables Evasion ( manual only ) while using certain Martial skills. After activating it, you need to wait before you can activate it again. Not available for some skills that perform special actions.

name: Mountain Press
description: A powerful shoulder strike. Chance to inflict [Stun] on the target. *If the stun debuff is prevented due to active resistance, the buff effect from the skill "Aggravate" will be applied.

name: Sonic Wave
description: Attacks with an impulse wave. Chance to inflict [Tumble] on the target.

name: Earthbind
description: Attacks enemies around you by shaking the ground. Chance to inflict [Stop] on the targets. Restore small amount of HP by hitting a target.

name: Triple Kick
description: Attacks the target three times quickly. Critical rates are higher than normal attacks.

name: Rush
description: Quick consecutive attacks. Action Speed increases for a few seconds including Rush activated.

name: Asura Aura
description: Unleashes the demon power that is hidden inside. While active, ATK increases and if you receive damage, MP will be used to mitigate the damage, but in exchange, you will lose ATK MP Recovery and MP Cost of all skills except Martial and Crusher skills will increase.

name: Seismic Stomp
description: Throws your opponent off balance with a heavy stomp. Chance to inflict [Flinch] on the target. If successful, a large amount of MP will be restored.

name: Spin Sweep
description: Trips your opponent with a leg sweep. Chance to inflict [Tumble] on the target. If successful, you will perform additional attacks and gain a buff for a few seconds.

name: Flash Blink
description: Sends out a residual image to attack. This skill attacks with "normal attack proration". The hit count increases according to the number of Evasions used. The power of the next close range attack increases.

name: Martial Mastery
description: Gets better at using Knuckles. ATK of Knuckles increases.

name: Martial Discipline
description: Deepens understanding of Knuckles. Increases attack speed of Knuckles. Increases damage of Knuckle skills a little.

name: Chakra
description: Restores MP a little and adds a buff to reduce the next damage for a few seconds. Increases Attack MP Recovery a little during the effect. Effective on party members.

name: Energy Control
description: Controls the flow of energy and turns it aside. Nullifies the damage received while performing it and receives the buffs of Chakra except the MP Recovery effect. *The level of Chakra that activates will not surpass the level of Energy Control acquired.

name: Aggravate
description: Keenly attacks the target again. Chance to deal additional damage with normal attacks of Knuckles.

name: Strong Chase Attack
description: Enhances the power of small attacks. Increases your accuracy and enhances the additional damage of [Aggravate].

name: Slide
description: Slides at a high speed to cut the distance and move closer to enemy. The accuracy of the next skill used will increase.

name: Flash Stab
description: Sharply attack an enemy with a quick movement.

name: Cannon Spear
description: Attack an enemy by throwing the halberd. The range increases as the skill levels up.

name: Dragon Tail
description: Whirl around the Halberd and swipe enemies. While active, damage taken will be reduced 2 times. Chance to inflict [Tumble]. Unable to inflict Tumble on boss monsters.

name: Dive Impact
description: The Halberd thrusted breaks the earth in time. Generate a mass explosion and deal additional damage after a while with a chance to inflict [Dazzled] when the skill is activated. Become invincible when activating the skill.

name: Dragon Tooth
description: Jump toward a target and attack. After using the skill, you will return to the original place. It has high Defense Ignorance and Critical Rate but has no bonus on power.

name: Draconic Charge
description: Unleashes the rage of a dragon. Activates when it is full or when you move. Accumulates more rage if you sense danger when charging. Be careful not to miss as the range of the charge attack is only 8 meters.

name: Deadly Spear
description: Accurately thrust an enemy and deal fatal damage. It takes time to activate, but it ignores certain amount of defense and has a high chace to inflict critical damage, and when it happens, the MP Cost for the next skill used is halved.

name: Strike Stab
description: Thrust an enemy with a quick movement. The damage increases if the target has a status ailment. Have a low chance to deal critical.

name: Chronos Drive
description: Repeat the fact that you penetrated a target. Grant a buff to restore small amount of MP and deal damage over time to the target for a few seconds.

name: Infinite Dimension
description: Repeated spear attacks that transcend time and space. Repeatedly performs wide-ranging attacks around a target. Chance to inflict [Dazzled]. If Chronos Drive is in effect, extra MP will be recovered.

name: Punish Ray
description: Cast a magic using the Halberd to resemble a staff. Deal magic damage affected by ATK. Critical Rates of the next 3 skills increases.

name: Blitz Spike
description: A swift spear thrust wrapped in lightning. Chance to inflict [Paralysis] when activated near the target. If paralyzed, the target will take additional magic damage. When activated at a distance, lightning spears that automatically attack approaching enemies will be summoned.

name: Lightning Hail
description: A spear technique that summons multiple lightning strikes from the sky. Generates multiple attacks that deal magic damage around the target. More likely to hit paralyzed targets. Grants invincibility to yourself when activated.

name: Thor's Hammer
description: A spear technique that calls down a massive lightning strike. A magic attack with guaranteed critical, but the damage will be split among targets caught in the blast. Once activated, your Additional Magic, Magic Pierce, and Accuracy Rate will increase for a certain period of time.

name: Halberd Mastery
description: Get better at using Halberds. ATK increases when you equip a Halberd.

name: Critical Spear
description: Learn the mastery of Halberds. Critical Rate increases when you equip a Halberd.

name: Tornado Lance
description: Gains 1 unit of tornado power when a halberd skill hits. Your halberd gets stronger as you accumulate more tornado power. Half of the tornado power will be lost if attacked.

name: Quick Aura
description: Increase your speed with the fighting spirit. Activate this skill by consuming HP instead of MP. Increase ASPD for a certain period of time.

name: War Cry of Struggle
level_info: Skill War Cry of Struggle Level 2
description: The roar of life in a critical situation. Restore MP a little. The amount of the MP restoration increases as the current HP is low.

name: Godspeed Wield
description: Consumes MaxMP and able to stack 3 times at most. Enhances ASPD/Action Speed/Evasion Recharge for a short time and greatly decreases Physical & Magic Resistance. The effect ends when taking damage.

name: Almighty Wield
description: Alleviates the amount of each resistance decreased due to the skill "Godspeed Wield". Chance to gain invincibility ( based on AGI ) when taking damage. This effect may trigger ( once every 10 seconds ). Also grants a passive effect that boosts the physical damage of Halberd skills.

name: Buster Lance
description: Attack by throwing a spear from a distance. The further you are from the target, the weaker it is. The skill will change if certain conditions are met and the distance-based power depletion will also be minimized.

name: Issen
description: Slash an enemy at a blinding speed. High Critical Rate at the second hit.

name: Pulse Blade
description: Slash an enemy with an aerial slash at a distance. The damage decreases as you get further away from the target. You can move when sheathing the katana.

name: Triple Thrust
description: Quickly approach and thrust a target. Move behind a target when attacking. Increases the damage of the next skill a little.

name: Hasso Happa
description: Slash all enemies in a certain space. Deal damage to enemies around you without fail. You can move when sheathing the katana.

name: Tenryu Ransei
description: Furiously slash consecutively. Power increases for a while everytime you use the skill ( 4 Times at Most ). Special attack is applied to Magadachi/Zantei Settetsu by meeting certain conditions and the buff duration increases.

name: Kasumisetsu Getsuka
description: Attacks the target with a series of slashes and greatly reduces the damage received while it is active. Performs a special attack if Tenryu Ransei is in effect, and the number of times it is used determines the duration of the power increase.

name: Garyou Tensei
description: The ultimate slash. The power increases every time you use certain Mononofu Skills. ( 10 Times at Most ) Power increases against targets inflicted with [Armor Break]. Critical Rate is extremely low.

name: Shadowless Slash
description: Rapidly slashes the enemy. It's so fast that even the enemy doesn't know when the katana leaves its scabbard. Attacks with high accuracy and grants 2 of Garyou Tensei's buffs. You can move when sheathing the katana.

name: Pommel Strike
description: Strike an enemy with the pommel. Chance to inflict [Paralysis]. Chance to inflict [Stun] if the target is paralyzed.

name: Magadachi
description: Parry an enemy's attack and reduce damage only once. Nullify ailments, recover MP a little, and at least 1 HP remains when taking fatal damage at certain amount of HP. Just deal damage if you don't parry. MP restored decreases if used with combo.

name: Zantei Settetsu
description: Furiously slash an enemy taking its attack. Nullify damage once and do additional attack. Chance to inflict [Armor Break] with it.

name: Bushido
description: Learn how to be a Mononofu. HP, MP and Accuracy increase a little. ATK increases when equipping a Katana. Side note: (the following notes are not part of this or any other Mononofu passive, rather being hidden innate effects of Main Katana ) • Auto Attacks of Main Katana are treated as Unsheathe Attacks • You can slide to any direction after an auto attack by using movement input during the auto attack animation if your are not afflicted with [Slow] or [Stop]; the same slide can also be performed after certain Mononofu Skills (conditions are listed within the info of said skills) • After performing a slide , gains a buff that lasts until you perform an auto attack ; the auto attack that consumes the buff will have its damage doubled , gains 50% bonus AMPR, will always deal critical hits , and give 1 Garyou Tensei stack • This slide action can be disabled by equipping Sprint Sheathe Remover registlet

name: Shukuchi
description: A technique to move fast. Quickly move within the range when doing normal attacks. Increase the ability of the next normal attack. Unavailable during [Slow/Stop].

name: Nukiuchi Sennosen
description: A sword-drawing technique that is like a miracle. When not attacking for a certain period of time, the normal attack with Shukuchi will be greatly enhanced. The less HP you have, the more powerful it is.

name: Two-Handed
description: Wield the weapon with both hands. Various stats are enhanced if Sub-Weapon is empty. Critical Damage with a Katana greatly increases.

name: Meikyo Shisui
description: Sharpen your focus. Critical Rate greatly increases for a short time and Critical Damage, DEF, and MDEF decrease. The effect ends when you use a skill.

name: Kairiki Ranshin
description: Release the demonic power inside. Increase ATK/Attack MP Recovery/Normal Attack Power. Enhance Defense Pierce/Critical Rate of Garyou Tensei. Inflict [Ignition] on yourself when activated.

name: Dauntless
description: A strong determination to confront the enemy. Dauntless automatically accumulates when fighting against a powerful enemy. Grants various buffs for every 10 Dauntless points accumulated. Defeating the enemy consumes its counts and it will deplete over time.

name: Auspicious Wind
description: Activates by chance when your attack misses or when you manage to dodge with Evasion. For 30 sec, Close-range ATK power/Critical Damage/Accuracy slightly increases, max 3 stacks. The effect increases based on the Mononofu skill tree level.

name: Gust
description: Assumes a dual-katana stance. Removes and converts Unsheathe Power into ATK and Weapon ATK. Reactivating Gust while it's in effect will produce a different effect based on the key input. The effect ends when you move while sheathing your katana.

name: Zephyr Rush
description: Escapes danger like a sudden breeze ( only while in Gust state ). Gains invincibility while in the air, then descends and performs a slash after some time or upon key input. The power increases based on the duration of invincibility, but it will be a MISS if there's no target at the landing point.

name: Super Gust
description: Improves dual-wielding technique through daily training. Increases the power of "Gust's" normal attack (all 3 stages) and all skills it changes to.

name: Bouncing Blade
description: A defense technique using scabbard. A counterattack is carried out 1 time only if you get hurt while holding a scabbard. If successful, some HP will be restored. MP Cost of the next skill used is reduced and accuracy increases.

name: Dual Sword Mastery
description: You can equip 2 One-Handed Swords. Reduces the decline in Accuracy Rate and Critical Rate as this skill levels up.

name: Twin Slash
description: Slash the target with the swords. Increases critical damage.

name: Spinning Slash
description: Slash and blow away enemies around you. Dual Element ( One-Handed Sword ). Generate whirlwind and deal damage. Chance to inflict [Blind].

name: Phantom Slash
description: Slash a target with lightning speed. Dual Element ( One-Handed Sword ). Become invincible mode while in action and able to cancel the mode by moving the character. Chance to kill weak monsters except bosses. Chance to inflict [Freeze] on the target.

name: Aerial Cut
description: A sword technique that releases windy blades. Dual Element with ( One-Handed Sword ). While deploying Spinning Slash, press the button to move forward and 200 MP will be consumed additionally to unleash powerful attacks.

name: Cross Parry
description: Attack a target parrying the target's attack. Reduce Physical/Magic damage while the skill is in action. Enhance ATK and ASPD for 30 seconds when reducing damage.

name: Charging Slash
description: Charges toward the target using two swords. Passes through the target and deals damage to the enemies in a straight line. Categorized as an Unsheathe Attack.

name: Shadowstep
description: Quickly move behind a target's back. Enhance Attack MP Recovery until the next skill. Increase Critical Rate of skill attack one time.

name: Shining Cross
description: A pair of light blades slashes darkness. Dual Element ( One-Handed Sword ). Deal more damage as the distance is closer. Restore MP with Critical. Grant a buff to restore small amount of HP, and it cannot be overwritten.

name: Lunar Misfortune
description: Dazzling moonlight. Dual Element with ( One-Handed Sword ). Press the back button right after it activates to quickly retreat and pierce the enemy with flying moonlight blade.

name: Twin Buster Blade
description: Consecutive double slash surrounded by an aura. A two-stage attack with high critical potential. Performs a chain of slashes first, then an AoE that grows stronger as more targets are involved.

name: Reflex
description: Greatly raises Evasion Recharge for a short time. Decreases DEF and MDEF a lot.

name: Flash Blast
description: Dual Element ( One Handed Sword ). Enhance Unsheathe Power for a short period of time and add a powerful counter when activating Evasion. It is activated when using [Shadowstep].

name: Storm Reaper
description: Attacks the target while jumping back swiftly. The power of the next close-range attack increases based on the distance you've jumped back. Invincible while jumping back.

name: Dual Sword Control
description: Increases ASPD of Dual Swords. Reduces the disadvantages of Dual Swords.

name: Godspeed
description: Enhances AGI and Unsheathe Attacks such as First Attack, Evasion Attacks and certain skills.

name: Saber Aura
description: The two blades emit a divine light. Increase various stats and movement speed. Continuously use HP while the effect is active. The effect ends when you become unable to use HP. Unable to use redundantly.

name: Crescent Saber
description: A special skill that can be activated while Saber Aura is active. Restores HP and the number of Evasions. Greatly raises Critical Rate and always halves MP Cost except for magic skills. However, if you take damage from an enemy...

name: Aerial Slay
description: Slashes your enemy while trifling with them. When activated with a combo ( except as opener ), the required MP becomes 100. You can move with the directional keys while the skill is active.

name: Horizon Cut
description: Surprises your enemy with a swift backhand slash. Restores half of the MP consumed by your next skill. The required MP becomes 300 when used as a combo opener and 0 when used as a combo finisher. You will tumble if you take damage while it is active.

name: Sting Blade
description: Closes the distance with a very sharp thrust. As long as it is not a Graze, hitting the target will boost your piercing power. The power increases further based on the piercing power that exceeds the maximum value.

name: Forefist Punch
description: A sharp straight punch. Inflict critical damage to target. Reduce damage received 1 time only while the effect is active.

name: Goliath Punch
description: A punch that can even knock down powerful enemy. Charge Skill ( 6 levels ). The area of attack is extremely small. The power decreases if left unused for too long after the highest charge level is reached.

name: God Hand
description: A punch to dispel disaster. Damage is reduced at all times while active. A successful damage reduction will raise the power of Crusher Skills for 60 seconds. ( Max 3 Stacks )

name: Divine Rigid Body
description: Perfecting the hand of god. May reduce Fractional Damage and increase Ailment Resistance while God Hand is in effect. MP is slightly restored each time the damage gets reduced. ( max 2 times )

name: Breathwork
description: A technique to control your breathing quickly. Immediately restores your HP when activated. HP is also restored when the next skill activates. Breathwork resilience declines for a while.

name: Floating Kick
description: Fly from a distance to kick target. Increases critical damage when used normally, and it will hit the target without fail if used while moving. Critical damage only goes up to a certain value.

name: Geyser Kick
description: A terrifyingly fast and powerful flying kick. The skill mechanism changes depending on distance. When activated from a long distance, the power increases and additionally the Breathwork acquired will be activated.

name: Combination
description: Performs quick consecutive punches. This skill has "normal attack proration". Critical rate increases as skill level goes up.

name: Annihilator
description: The essence of destruction. Learn this skill to get a passive effect that raises Breathwork's HP recovery amount. Reduce MP Cost of the next skill used when it's Lv10. Use knuckles as main weapon to get additional effect.

name: Terrablast
description: A technique to crush the earth and use the uplifted bedrock as a shield. Deals damage to your surroundings and gets a barrier based on the HP consumed for 10 seconds. ( Can't be overwritten ). Critical is guaranteed if Annihilator is in effect and the target is inflicted with Armor Break.

name: Auto-Device
description: A technique allowing magic device to assist attack. Performs a normal attack on target after being idle for 60 seconds. Efficiency reduced for long-range (8m or more).

name: Express Aid
description: Raises and rushes the output of magic device. Increases traveling speed toward the target of "First Aid" and reduces damage received up to a certain number of times.

name: Micro Heal
description: Sharing a little comfort. Slightly restores your HP and the HP of the party member who has lost the most HP.

name: Resurrection
description: A secret technique to resuscitate those who can no longer fight. The waiting time for those around you ( within 16m ) to revive instantly becomes 0 s. *Not available if First Aid is not applicable. *Not usable with combo.

name: Enhance
description: A technique that boosts outstanding abilities further. Enhances the attack power of the party member with the highest ATK and MATK ( 1 each ).

name: Stabiliz
description: A technique that improves accuracy. Increases the stability of Critical Rate and Magic Damage, and mitigates the decrease in stability of Graze hits for 45 seconds. Removes [Fatigue] when activated.

name: Sprite Upgrade
description: Extends the duration of Auto-Device, Counterforce, Astral Lance, and Stabiliz.

name: Sprite Shield
description: A secret technique to convert energy into mana. Consumes HP to instantly restore 100 MP. Reduces the damage taken next and the chance of being inflicted with a status ailment.

name: Counterforce
description: A supporting technique with magic device. Deploys a magic circle for 30 seconds to attack the target if a party member in sight ( up to 24m ) receives damage. ( Max 3 )

name: Astral Lance
description: An attack technique that efficiently recycles depleted mana. Attacks by releasing a powerful magic lance for every 500 MP consumed for 90 seconds. ( max 1 lance )

name: Magic Vulcan
description: A revolving magic cannon technique. Inflicts consecutive magic damage to the target. MP can be consumed additionally to continue attacking, but the power will diminish bit by bit. This attack does not cause proration.

name: Cursed Altar
description: Devours the soul with a curse. Puts a "curse" on the target. If successful, an effect that continuously deals damage to the target is additionally applied ( damage is reduced against bosses ).

name: Ignition
description: Attacks by causing the opponent's mana to burn. Deals unstable magic damage. Low chance to inflict [Weaken]. The chance increases with higher DEX and Sprite skill tree level.

name: Terrawrym
description: Fires a magic projectile that ambush from underground. A magic projectile is sent crawling along the ground toward the target and triggers a small AoE when it hits. Passes through any targets in the way and inflicts [Stop] on them.

name: Faux Weapon
description: Wields a weapon created with mana. Targets a single enemy. The power increases with higher AGI and DEX.

name: Slash Reaper
description: Protects yourself from looming danger with magical blades. If conditions are met, the number of magical blades increases ( up to 99, max 5 deployed at once ). Reusing the skill sends the deployed magical blades to strike the target.

name: Lebenglanz
description: A forbidden technique that reverses the phase of life that is lost to create explosive power. Puts a "Life Bomb" on the target. It explodes and deals damage when the effect ends.

name: Shield Mastery
description: Enhance Attack Speed when equipping a shield.

name: Shield Bash
description: Bash with the shield. Chance to inflict [Stun] on the target.

name: Shield Cannon
description: Throw the shield like a cannonball. Chance to inflict [Stun] on the target. Damage dealt increases if the target is stunned.

name: Guard Strike
description: Attack repelling an enemy's attack. Deal damage to a target when Guard is activated. The damage dealt depends on Guard Power and the refinement value of your shield.

name: Force Shield
description: DEF and Physical Resistance are added when equipping a shield.

name: Magical Shield
description: Increases MDEF and Magic Resistance when equipping a shield.

name: Shield Uppercut
description: A powerful uppercut with a shield. Chance to inflict [Tumble]. Damage Reduction and Guard will be activated during this skill.

name: Dual Shields
description: Your iron will is stronger than a castle wall. Equips two shields and maintains the state of Guard during combat. Heavy armor increases Guard range and removes the interval of normal attacks.

name: Shield Repair
description: Repairs your shield and recovers its durability. Recovers the Guard power consumed. Also recovers MP depending on the recovered Guard.

name: Belagerung
description: Only available during the Skill: "Dual Shields". Deals AoE damage twice and ends "Dual Shields". Increases damage to an immobile target.

name: Protection
description: Increase party members' Physical Resistance and decrease Magic Resistance for a limited time.

name: Aegis
description: Increase party members' Magic Resistance and decrease Physical Resistance for a limited time.

name: Guardian
description: Creates an area that reduces damage taken. Increase Guard Recharge. ATK decreases and Aggro greatly increases as more mates are in the area. Your shield's refinement value affects the damage reduction.

name: Throwing Knife
description: Attack by throwing a dagger. MP Cost becomes 0 when reaching Lv10 and normal attack proration will be applied.

name: Spike Dart
description: Disturb the target's movement by throwing a dagger at the feet. The damage increases as DEX is higher. Chance to inflict [Slow Down] on the target.

name: Gatling Knife
description: Throw a lot of knives single-mindedly. The damage increases as STR, AGI and DEX are higher.

name: Amazing Throw
description: An astounding throwing skill. Add the chance to increase hit counts to all the Dagger Skills.

name: Mad Dagger
description: Summons and controls a levitating dagger. Hurls the dagger at the target or a different target in combat to deal damage. After using the skill, the dagger follows you and delivers follow-up attacks in tandem with your normal attacks.

name: Poison Dagger
description: Attack with a poisoned dagger. The damage increases as INT is higher. Chance to inflict [Poison].

name: Double Stab
description: Raises the next dagger skill power used after Evasion. Requires some time to reactivate after 1 activation. Reactivate faster by leveling the skill. Has no effect on skills that do not consume MP.

name: Hidden Arm
description: Chance to add small damage to normal attacks by equipping a dagger.

name: Intensive Knife
description: Increase the damage and activation rate of Hidden Arm.

name: Mail Breaker
description: Ignore certain amount of DEF when using Hidden Arm. The next normal attack gets Critical Rate +75, Attack MP Recovery +100% at a small probability.

name: Knife Combat
description: Normal attacks turn into Dagger attacks. Increases Critical Rate and Attack MP Recovery. Reduces Evasion consumption during normal attack. Removes "normal attack proration". The effect ends when you use another skill.

name: Flincher Knife
description: Chance to inflict [Flinch] to a foe targeting you and turns into Knife Combat mode. Increases damage and Physical Pierce when not being targeted.

name: Rolling Bite
description: A dagger technique blending evasive maneuvers with surprise attacks. Reduces damage taken while moving. Closes in to deal damage and enters Knife Combat state. Pressing the directional key opposite to the direction the character is facing will cancel the attack.

name: Assault Attack
description: Rush at the target. Chance to inflict [Slow Down] on the target.

name: Parry
description: Parry attacks using the weapon. Chance to reduce physical damage. The skill will not be activated with Guard.

name: P. Defense
description: Perform perfect defense. Reduce damage to 0 with a shield and restore small amount of HP.

name: Fareth
description: Staying still increases the effect ( 5 Levels ). Enhances Attack Speed, Physical Pierce, Normal Attack Power, Fractional Damage Reduction. VIT affects Attack Speed and Physical Pierce.

name: Aftershield
description: Gains a damage reduction effect for a certain period of time after activating P. Defense. Acquiring this skill will slightly increase Neutral Resistance permanently too.

name: Provoke
description: Provoke the enemy to target you.

name: Rage Sword
description: Attack with raw hostility. It is a special attack to get more Aggro. When targeted, Critical Rate increases and MP Cost for the next skill used will be halved.

name: Binding Strike
description: Generates a shock wave and deal damage to enemies around you. Chance to inflict [Stop] on targets. A special attack that produces a lot of Aggro.

name: Knight Will
description: Shows effect if target turns hostile towards you. Aggro will increase more easily and the effect of Lv 10 Knight Skills up to Skill Tree Lv 3 will be enhanced further. ( Does not apply to Tier 3 and Tier 4 skills )

name: Blink Sword
description: Throws a sword to instantly close the distance to the target. Chance to inflict [Flinch]. When successful, Fractional Damage can be reduced for 3 seconds and the effect of Fareth will not be lost even if you move.

name: Sonic Thrust
description: Attack with sword aura causing enemy to lose his balance. Chance to inflict [Tumble] on the target.

name: Revenir
description: A hit that overwhelms a powerful enemy in the way. Hit count increases (max 3 hits) if conditions are met. However, the effect that adds hit count won't be active if a status ailment is inflicted. This attack does not cause proration.

name: Knight's Stance
description: Signifies the vow of a knight. Increase VIT and the amount of aggro raised for 6 minutes. Fractional damage from monster is slightly reduced if you are pulling aggro toward each other while the effect is active.

name: Knight's Remedy
description:
A portion of damage received while Knight's Stance is active will be accumulated and restored as HP.
When Knight's Stance is activated again, the total accumulation will be used to restore HP.

name: Knight Pledge
description: Creates an area that gives protection with the sword of oaths. Within the area, ATK increases and high damage resistance ( decreases with each use ) is given except to yourself. Disappears if you get a knockback. The more characters in the area, the weaker the effect will be.

name: Bless
description: Restore HP a little at fixed intervals. The heal amount and duration depend on Lv.

name: Gloria
description: Increases DEF and MDEF for a short time. Also raises Guard Recharge if you equip a shield.

name: Enhanced Bless
description: Enhance the healing effect of [Bless]. If the level of [Bless] is 10, add more duration, healing amount and Staff bonuses.

name: Royal Heal
description: Restores your HP and that of the allies around. Unlike Heal from Support Skill, there is no effect to reduce revival time.

name: Sacred Teaching
description: Grants temporary HP exceeding your MaxHP when recovering with a Heal-type skill( * ). ATK and MATK will slightly increase according to the value of temporary HP gained.

name: Holy Fist
description: Smite evil with Light elemental punch. Deals physical and magic damage at the same time. It is categorized as a Physical Skill.

name: Holy Light
description: Punish evil monsters with holy power. Deal magic damage of Light element to a target and recover some HP.

name: Ether Barrier
description: Generate a barrier that absorbs shock. The resistance to the status ailment: [Flinch] increases for a short period of time.

name: Prayer
description: Offers a prayer to increase Mana. Raises MATK for some time. Chance to remove [Weaken] when activated.

name: Aspis Soul
description: The shield of faith. Gains a permanent effect that reduces Fractional Damage aimed at you. Also gains an effect that prevents status ailments at a certain time.

name: Staff Thrust
description: A powerful hit with a staff. Ignores the target's defense as STR gets higher. Chance to inflict [Flinch] on the target.

name: Exorcism
description: Performs light element magic attack around you. Halves MP Cost of the next skill used. The power increases further when used on a dark element target, and there is a chance to inflict either [Dizzy/Dazzled/Fear].

name: Holy Book
description: Dark Resistance slightly increases for 10 minutes. When dealing magic damage to a non-light element target, there is a chance to get an extra activation of the Holy Light learned. •Not all magic damage can activate the Holy Light.

name: Nemesis
description: Deals physical damage on the enemy and makes it a target of divine retribution. The effect will stack and when activating this skill again, a magic AoE will be added according to the number of stacks.

name: Holy Grace
description: A miracle that blesses the good ones and punishes the evil ones. Grants an effect that maintains item effect once to the party for a certain period of time even if you get knocked out. Halves the MP Cost for the character that activates Holy Grace when using the next skill.

name: Kick
description: Kick an enemy and create distance. Deal damage and Knock Back the target.

name: Sunrise Arrow
description: A strong shot with the energy of the Sun. Deal damage in the straight line toward the target. 2x Damage on Sleeping enemies.

name: Magic Arrow
description: Strengthen arrows with magic. Slightly increase Weapon ATK and Attack MP Recovery. Normal Attack is enhanced by MATK. The effect ends after using Normal Attacks certain number of times.

name: Satellite Arrow
description: A highly difficult technique to attack from a high altitude. You need to be highly skilled to hit the target as the attack takes some time.

name: Focus
description: Issues a hunting command. Marks an enemy as a "target". Increases long-range attack power ( from party members too ) to the target.

name: Sleep Trap
description: Set a sleeping gas trap. Chance to inflict [Sleep] on the target. Unable to set at feet. It can be broken by Area of Effect.

name: Bear Trap
description: Set a bear trap. Chance to inflict [Stop] on the target. Unable to set at feet. It can be broken by Area of Effect.

name: Land Mine
description: Set an explosive trap. Low chance to inflict [Ignite] on the trapped enemy. Unable to set under the enemy's feet. The trap can be broken by Area of Effect.

name: Dark Trap
description: Sets a trap that steals power. Low chance to inflict [Lethargy] on the target that steps on it. Can't be set directly under the enemy's feet and may be broken by AOE.

name: Camouflage
description: Greatly reduces aggro that depends on MP consumption, increases ATK and Critical Rate for 180 seconds. If targeted while the effect is active, the effect will be lost and you will be ( * )stunned.

name: Homing Shot
description: Shoots a magic arrow that pursues threats. "Normal attack proration" is applied. The number of shots and accuracy get higher depending on the skill level. Slightly increases MP when hitting a target.

name: Detection
description: Ability to sense danger in nature. Reduces Aggro against you and slightly increases Critical Rate for 40sec. The effect ends when you are targeted.

name: Cyclon Arrow
description: An arrow skill that creates a tornado. Deals small damage but has a chance to inflict [Flinch] to a target and engulfs the monsters near it.

name: Vertical Air
description: A deadly arrow skill combining evasion and counterattack. The hit counts increase depending on the distance. ( Up to 3 times ) Grants [Invincible] to yourself when activating the skill.

name: Hunter Bowgun
description: Enhances the versatility of hunting. Even with a non-arrow sub-weapon, Hunter Skills will exhibit the properties of arrow skills. Raising the skill level will increase Bowgun ATK.

name: Multiple Hunt
description: Hunting techniques using Sub-Weapon. When activated using a weapon other than Dagger, Magic Device, or Shield, it deals damage to the target and there is a high chance to inflict [Armor Break] with higher Physical Pierce.

name: Hunter Knowledge
description: Accumulates knowledge about various hunting tools. Increases the power of the skill "Multiple Hunt".

name: Assassin Stab
description: Deal a fatal blow to target. The effectiveness of the attack depends on the hit direction. Aim for target's back to maximize it.

name: Backstep
description: A technique to instantly escape from danger. If you manage to move a certain distance away, the power of Assassin Stab used next increases. Restore a little MP when the use is timed with the monster's attack warning.

name: Arcane Strike
description: A secret technique passed down from an assassin squad. Use all MP and enhances Attack MP Recovery until the next skill is activated. Significantly reduce Aggro on you when not targeted.

name: Sicarius
description: Raises the power of Back Stab with lasting effect. Successful Back Stab execution will slightly enhance ATK and Physical Pierce for a short time. Damage received will be slightly reduced and the enhancement effect will be lost.

name: Secret Assassin
description: Deepens your understanding of assassination techniques. Increases the power of the skill "Assassin Stab" and "Arcane Strike".

name: Evasion
description: A technique to improve the ability to dodge. Increase dodge rate for a certain period of time and remove Status Ailment: [Slow].

name: Serum
description: A technique to ease and relieve pain. Reduce damage over time due to status ailments: [Poison] and [Ignite] for a certain period of time.

name: Foresight
description: Exceed the limit of your ability to dodge. Lower monster's minimum accuracy and makes it easier to dodge attacks. The power of Assassin Stab is also raised.

name: Shadow Walk
description: Briefly grants additional attack effect together with Evasion if not targeted. (Range depends on weapon.) Certain moves enhance the additional attack, but the effect is reset if you take damage while targeted. Can't be used repeatedly.

name: Assault Chase
description: Restores Evasion by 50% if a new buff is gained and decreases the consumption of Evasion toward (or around) the attack target for 180 seconds. The buff effect will end too once the remaining Evasion count hits 0.

name: Venom Injection
description: An assassination technique by applying poison to your weapon. Consumes your HP to gain the chance to inflict poison during normal attacks. The chance depends on the stats of dagger, ninjutsu scroll and changes based on Critical or Graze.

name: Corrosive Poison
description: Enables the stacking of poison with Venom Injection ( max +2 ). If it turns into enhanced poison due to the stacking, the player's attack will also be able to inflict poison damage.

name: Venom Thief
description: Absorbs the corrosive poison from the target to restore your own HP and get rid of the poison status. If it is enhanced poison, MP will also be restored. If not poisoned, you will get an effect that prevents you from getting poisoned.

name: Death Reception
description: Uses the poison absorbed with Venom Thief to inflict damage and Deadly Poison to the target. Depending on the poison used, damage that inflicts poison to your surroundings will also be generated additionally.

name: Poison Master
description: Increases the duration of the status ailment [Poison] and the power of the skill "Death Reception". Damage from Deadly Poison may also inflict [Poison] ( depends on Venom Injection ).

name: Familia
description: Summons familiar and while it's around, MATK, MaxMP and Additional Magic increase a little. The familiar may flee if it receives damage.

name: Lightning
description: Familiar is told to perform a lightning magic. Deals wind element magic damage to the target. Chance to inflict [Paralysis] on the target.

name: Blizzard
description: Familiar is told to perform a snowstorm magic. Creates a wide AOE that does water element magic damage. Chance to inflict [Freeze] on the target.

name: Meteor Strike
description: Familiar is told to perform a meteorite magic. Drops 3 meteorites near the target. Chance to inflict [Ignite] & [Dizzy]. You need luck too to make them hit the target.

name: Imperial Ray
description: An attack technique that detonates condensed mana. An additional attack with certain Magic Skills will trigger a massive mana explosion that guarantees a critical hit and inflicts [Weaken] to targets with elements you are weak to.

name: Magic Research
description: Deepens your understanding of magic through research. Increases the power of "Imperial Ray" and shortens the casting time of magic used by the familiar.

name: Mana Crystal
description: Creates crystal that restores Mana. Pick it up to restore a small amount of MP. The cast time becomes longer if the familiar is doing something else when the skill is used.

name: Stone Barrier
description: Familiar is told to perform a safeguard magic. It gives protection to reduce certain damage, but the damage from Ignite and Poison increases (drawback) . Can't be used repeatedly.

name: Advanced Familia
description: Summons and makes familiar act unpredictably. Lightning, Blizzard or Meteor Strike is cast randomly at fixed time intervals. Familiar's ability and the skill generated depends on the skill level acquired.

name: Kitty's Treasure
description: I'll put it here if there's any extra, meow! The skill "Mana Crystal" may be deployed after a successful cast by the familiar.

name: Cast Mastery
description: Accumulates knowledge to speed up incantation. Loses ATK in exchange for an increase in CSPD according to the acquisition status of Wizard Skills. The attack power of familiar will not decrease.

name: Crystal Laser
description: Shoots out mana from Mana Crystal in a straight line to attack. Slightly restores the MP of the party members within the attack area.

name: Overlimit
description: A secret technique to maximize element power. For 90 seconds, the power of all elements ( magic only ) except neutral increases, but CSPD decreases and 1% of Max HP is lost each time you cast.

name: Sorcery Guide
description: Mitigates CSPD loss due to Overlimit and increases element power further.

name: Shift
description: Slips into another dimension to escape from danger. During Shift, you will be unable to attack and MP will be drained continuously, but your aggro will be removed and you will always be [Invincible]. The effect cannot be triggered if you are being targeted.

name: Heavy Armor Mastery
description: Increases Guard Recharge when heavy-remodeled armor is equipped.

name: Advanced Guard
description: Increases ( Damage Reduction ) by Guard Power when heavy-remodeled armor is equipped. Also slightly increases Guard Recharge.

name: Physical Guard
description: Increases Ailment Resistance from Guard when running low on HP. Higher skill level enables the skill to be activated with more HP remaining.

name: Light Armor Mastery
description: Increases Evasion Recharge when light-remodeled armor is equipped.

name: Advanced Evasion
description: Increases Evasion Recharge when light-remodeled armor is equipped. The amount raised per level is the same as the effect of Light Armor Mastery .

name: Mirage Evasion
description: Evasion becomes usable while charging or casting. The effect of this skill is lost for a few seconds if used. The duration depends on the skill level.

name: Bloody Bite
description: A dark magic to feed on enemy's blood. Inflict damage to a target and absorb a part of damage dealt as HP. The heal amount depends on your level.

name: Dark Stinger
description: The power of darkness in your right arm bursts. Use 10% of the current HP and deal damage. Lower MaxHP for 10 seconds. (Up to 5 times.) If you use Bloody Bite while this effect is active, remove the negative effect and heal HP.

name: Red Tear
description: Hatred turns to tears of blood and takes down foes. When being targeted by a foe, you start bleeding. If not, reduce Aggro. HP Cost of Dark Energy is removed while it's active.

name: Soul Hunter
description: My determination got the best of me. Consuming HP raises the effect ( max 10 Levels ). Chance to inflict [Fear] on the target. Get MP Recovery if the effect is raised and wield the hunted soul as a scythe to attack the surroundings.

name: Sacrifice
description: Curse an enemy by sacrificing your life. Deal special damage using 10% of MaxHP. You will become Stunned if HP is not enough.

name: Demon Claw
description: The demon inside rages for blood. Attack the targets targeting allies. Attack up to 10 targets but damage is distributed. When activated, power increases as your HP is lower and does not generate Aggro.

name: Regretless
description: Even if my life ends here. I shall have no regrets. Restore all HP. Reduce MaxHP and enhance stats for a few seconds. (Can be overlapped.) You will die when the effect ends. First-Aid, Struggle, Revive Droplets Unavailable.

name: Eternal Nightmare
description: Are you living in a dream or a nightmare? Constantly consume HP to lower monster's defense and enhance Dark Power skills up to level 3. Raises Dark Resistance but lowers Light Resistance while active.

name: Intimidating Evil Eye
description: Makes the target flinch with a sharp glare. The lower the target's level, the higher the chance to inflict [Flinch]. If unsuccessful, inflicts [Slow]. Not expected to deal much damage.

name: Bewitching Evil Eye
description: Pins the target in place with evil power. Chance to inflict [Charm] on the target. Increases damage if the target is already charmed.

name: Black Flame Evil Eye
level_info: Skill Black Flame Evil Eye Level 3
description: Uses dark flames to burn the target who makes direct eye contact. Deals magic damage based on ATK or MATK, whichever is higher. Critical hit guaranteed when the enemy is targeting you. Overusing black flames comes at a price...

name: Chaotic Evil Eye
description: Swirling chaos torments the enemy. Exploits the target's weak element to deal magic damage and inflicts a status ailment ( randomly selected from 10 types ). Damage greatly increases if successful. Ignores Guard when the enemy is targeting you.

name: Magic Warrior Mastery
description: Reduce the ATK decrease applied when equipping a sub magic device and increase MATK and CSPD a little.

name: Conversion
description: When equipping One-Handed Swords, Two-Handed Swords, Bowguns and Knuckles, Weapon ATK affects MATK like Staffs and Magic Devices.

name: Resonance
description: Resonance of vitality and magic power. Enhance stats randomly for 30 seconds and average Current HP and MP. This skill cannot be overlapped. Unavailable if MaxHP is lower than MaxMP.

name: Enchanted Spell
description: A special magic that infuses a spell to a weapon in advance. Activates some magic skills by syncing them with certain actions. The cooldown time varies depending on the activated skills.

name: Dual Bringer
description: Keeps ATK and MATK high through resonance during the effect duration that depends on the ability of magic device. Gets a critical bonus when attacking a weakened target. This skill effect is only for Magic Blade Skills.

name: Ether Flare
description: A simplified magic for warriors. Chance to inflict [Ignite], if successful, ATK MP Recovery will increase for a few seconds. Skill power will increase further if it is also your weak element.

name: Element Slash
description: Slash enemies with a magic blade. The element depends on the sub magic device. Accuracy rates affect this skill. Chance to inflict [Weakness]

name: Enchant Sword
description: The element power turns into a blade that pierce through enemies. Attack with the target's weak element regardless of your element. Magic device ability increases Critical Rate during normal (physical) attacks, and Magic Pierce during magic attacks.

name: Enchanted Burst
description: Releases accumulated elemental power. Inflicts [Weaken] and the power increases ( Max 3 ) if Enchant Sword hits the target. Using more accumulated power will extend the effect that increases the power of Enchant Sword.

name: Union Sword
description: A secret technique of wielding a colossal sword created with mana. Performs a wide range attack in a straight line. When under the enhancement effect of Enchanted Burst, it will activate quickly by consuming its effect duration.

name: Siphon Barrier
description: A defense technique converted into mana through a barrier. Reduces physical/magic damage received during the skill and slightly restores MP. The amount restored increases if magic damage gets reduced.

name: Teleport
description: A technique to dodge attacks by instantly moving to another point. While casting Teleport, press a direction key to instantly move to that direction.

name: Siphon Recall
description: Gets an additional status that continues to restore MP when damage is successfully reduced by Siphon Barrier. The heal amount changes based on the value obtained from Siphon Barrier.

name: Float Dash
description: Urgently deploys magic device for high-speed flight. Movement speed greatly increases for 10 seconds in exchange for being unable to perform a normal attack. The effect ends when any skill is activated. MP Cost of the activated skill is halved.

name: Magic Skin
description: The refinement value of magic device will have the same damage reduction effect as that of shield. Furthermore, the more MP left, the more often physical/magic damage will be reduced.

name: Unarmed Mastery
description: Only usable when no Main or Sub-Weapon is equipped. The essence of unarmed combat. Gain Weapon ATK based on character's level. Also increase qi limit. Important note: • You must have both Main Weapon Slot and Sub-Weapon Slot empty in order to use any of the Bare Hand Skills • Using any non-Bare Hand skill will consume 20% of current Accumulate Qi (rounded down, minimum 1); this can only be reduced by the passive Ultima Qi Charge

name: Qi Charge
description: Only usable when no Main or Sub-Weapon is equipped. Use up MP to accumulate qi. ATK increases for 180 sec based on qi accumulated and Stability increases regardless of Qi amount.

name: Lion Rage
description: Only usable if no Main or Sub-Weapon is equipped. Boost Normal Attack and Critical Rate with qi for 30 sec at the cost of greatly lowered ASPD. Using another qi technique will end the effect.

name: Ultima Lion Rage
description: Raises Lion Rage effect to boost Normal Attack. If a critical hit is inflicted while Lion Rage is active, the effect that enhances attack skills will be accumulated. But if Internal Elixir is activated, the power will vanish.

name: Raving Storm
description: Only usable when no Main or Sub-Weapon is equipped. Boost Accuracy, ASPD, ATK MP Recovery and movement speed with qi for 30 sec. Using another qi technique ends the effect.

name: Ultima Raving Storm
description: When Raving Storm activates, Physical Pierce and chance to trigger Additional Melee are raised. The effect ends when a non-Bare Hand skill is used, but the MP Cost will be halved. The effect is also lost when Internal Elixir activates.

name: Internal Elixir
description: Only usable when no Main or Sub-Weapon is equipped. Use qi to recover HP for a certain period of time and reduce damage received. Attack power goes down and damage from poison increases while it is in effect. Using another qi technique ends the effect.

name: Clash of Enmity
description: Only usable if no Main or Sub-Weapon is equipped. If you and a target are pulling aggro towards each other, the damage taken from the target will be reduced. Chance to prevent qi consumption if you receive damage while Internal Elixir is active.

name: Miracle Comeback
description: When Internal Elixir is not activated and you get knocked out, it may auto-activate and restore your HP. Once activated, it won't reactivate for some time.

name: Ultima Qi Charge
description: Mitigates qi consumption when using skills other than Bare Hand Skills and slightly increases Attack MP Recovery.

name: Hidden Talent
description: If there are no slots, just hold them. Equips 3 crystas and get the ability of the 2 corresponding crystas when Lion Rage/Raving Storm/Internal Elixir activates.

name: Earthshaker
description: Only usable when no Main or Sub-Weapon is equipped. Get a barrier according to the qi accumulated by this skill. Increase all elemental advantages, physical pierce, and stability. The effect ends when Internal Elixir is used.

name: Ninjutsu
description: Foreign and unconventional ninja magic. Activates a random ninjutsu when used. If a Ninjutsu Scroll skill is activated, the level will be the same as the level of this skill. EX Skill "Create Ninjutsu Scroll" can be used.

name: Ninja Spirit
description: Learns the rules of shinobi (ninja). Slightly boosts Dodge and reduces Aggro a little. If this skill is Lv10, the skill "Two-Handed" will be applicable even if a Ninjutsu Scroll is equipped.

name: Ninjutsu Drill I
description: Enhances the skills activated with Ninjutsu.

name: Ninjutsu Drill II
description: Enhances the skills activated with Ninjutsu. It doesn't matter whether you learn Ninjutsu Drill I or II first because the enhancement value will be the same.

name: L Boomerang
description: Throws Lepage's boomerang sword. It will only hit the target and return after traveling a certain distance with the chance of hitting the target again. The skill will do no damage without a boomerang.

name: L Boomerang II
description: Throws the boomerang while moving backward, however, it is less powerful. Without a boomerang, you will only move backward.

name: L Boomerang III
description: Critical Rate and Physical Pierce go up. The boomerang will go after the target. It will return after traveling a certain distance or colliding with an obstacle with the chance of hitting the target again. The skill will do no damage without a boomerang.

name: N Dragon Tooth
description: The Dragon Tooth invented by Nino. Attacks the target and moves backward. Slightly raises the piercing power of the next skill used. Acquiring the skill "Dragon Tooth" will increase the power further.

name: Healing Shot
description: Consumes your own HP ( min 100 ) and shoots a straight healing arrow toward the furthest party member. The heal amount is different for mercenary, partner, and pet.

name: Arrow Sharpening
description: Enhances the next normal attack used. STR increases Physical Pierce, AGI increases Action Speed, and DEX increases critical performance.

name: Survival Instinct
description: Increases MaxHP and Fractional Damage Reduction for 20 seconds when a party member gets knocked out. Doesn't activate if knocked out due to certain conditions.

name: Frontliner
description: The determination to never back down. Increases your own Aggro and raises the increase of Aggro for 60 seconds. Additionally gains Physical Barrier according to the number of nontarget members.

name: Frontliner II
description: Gains Magic Barrier too when gaining Physical Barrier from the skill "Frontliner". Additionally, there is a passive effect that increases MaxHP permanently in line with skill acquisition.

name: Grave Digger
description: Deploys a conceptual graveyard to prepare for necromancy. Spirit stacks are gained while in the graveyard. Spirit slowly returns if you leave the graveyard.

name: Phantom Missile
description: Sends forth evil spirits to attack. Performs a magic attack on the target by consuming spirit stacks ( max 10 ). Consuming more spirit increases its duration (number of hits), and its power increases with each critical hit ( physical ).

name: Blood Siphon
description: Puts a blood-sucking curse on the target. A portion of the damage dealt is absorbed as HP. Warning: Low chance to absorb status ailments too. Chance to inflict [Flinch] if VIT is 50 or higher. The curse is instantly removed when the target is too far.

name: Soul Stream
description: Unleashes a spiritual particle beam. Performs a magic attack. Restores MP and raises the chance to inflict [Lethargy] based on spirit stacks used. The number of spirit stacks used depends on the amount of MP consumed when the skill is activated. ( max 20 )

name: Skeleton Call
description: Uses 3 spirit stacks to summon a skeleton soldier. ( max 3 on the field ) The soldier performs close-range attack. It explodes and disappears when caught in an AoE. Attack power is based on ATK or MATK, whichever is higher.

name: Demonic Pact
description: A contract with a demon. The ability changes based on the amount of MP offered when forming the contract. Each attack by the demon costs the caster some HP. Reusing the skill will terminate the contract. The demon may betray you if things turn bad.

name: Fine Shovel
description: Gains additional spirit stacks when deploying "Grave Digger" for the first time. You can now continue gaining spirit stacks even when slightly away from the graveyard.

name: Harvest
description: Recovers a small amount of HP and MP instantly when a monster is killed. (activates only once per second.) A skeleton soldier will be summoned upon recovery if "Skeleton Call" has been acquired. ( There can't be more than 3 skeleton soldiers on the field. )

name: Opportunist
description: The effect of "Harvest" may still be applied even when a skeleton soldier explodes and disappears.

name: Tomb
description: Summons tombstones that spike out of the ground. Performs a physical attack on the target. Chance to inflict [Tumble] if VIT is 50 or higher. Using 3 spirit stacks adds an AoE attack, activating up to 3 times at once.

name: Skull Shaker
description: Delivers a heavy blow to the top of the head with a staff. Performs a physical attack to the target. Chance to inflict [Dizzy]. Each successful hit increases the power and may inflict [Stun] on the target. The effect resets upon inflicting [Stun].

name: Hazard Strike
description: A versatile staff technique that changes according to the situation. A physical attack that can trigger a follow-up move by consuming an additional 100 MP depending on key input. Up (high power), Left/Right (damage reduction), Down (backstep)

name: Play Dead
description: The waiting time to revive is reduced.

name: EXP Gain Up
description: EXP Gain from battles increases by 1% per skill level.

name: Drop Rate Up
description: Drop Rate from battles increases by 1% per skill level.

name: Safe Rest
description: Natural HP Regen increases.

name: HP Boost
description: MaxHP increases a little.

name: Fighter's High
description: Regenerate HP during combat. The healing amount is small. Regeneration Tick occurs once every 3 seconds

name: Short Rest
description: Natural MP Regen increases.

name: MP Boost
description: MaxMP increases a little.

name: Sober Analysis
description: Regenerate MP during combat. The healing amount is small. Regeneration Tick occurs once every 3 seconds

name: First Aid
description: "First Aid" effect in Support menu increases. The waiting time to revive is largely reduced.

name: Mini Heal
description: Restore the target's HP a little. Reduce the target's waiting time to revive if the target is knocked out. Mini Heal will target the Caster automatically if no target is specified

name: Recovery
description: Remove a target's one status ailment. If there is no ailment to remove, it becomes a buff to remove one ailment at once for a few seconds. Restore the user's MP a little when succeeding in removing an ailment. Recovery will target the Caster automatically if no target is specified

name: Sanctuary
description: Create a sanctuary and protect allies. Reduce damage taken while in the area. The amount depends on each player's MaxHP. Ineffective against fatal damage.

name: Heal
description: Restore a target's HP. Greatly shorten the time to revive when using this skill to a defeated player. Heal will target the Caster automatically if no target is specified

name: Life Recovery
description: Create an area that regenerates HP. The player's DEF decreases. The effect ends when the player take damage.

name: Brave Aura
description: Create an area that enhances ATK and weapon performance. The player's Accuracy Rate decreases. The effect ends when the player takes damage.

name: High Cycle
description: Create the area to shorten charge and cast time. Your MP restoration will be weakened. The effects will end when taking damage.

name: Quick Motion
description: Create an area that enhances Attack Speed. The user's Attack MP Recovery is lowered and the effect ends when you take damage.

name: Mana Recharge
description: Create an area that regenerates MP. The player's ATK decreases. The effect ends when the player takes damage.

name: Magic Barrier
description: Create an area that enhances DEF and armor performance. The player's Dodge Rate decreases. The effect ends when the player takes damage.

name: Immunity
description: Create an area that has chance to protect allies from status ailments. Your Attack Speed will be lowered. The effects will end when taking damage.

name: Fast Reaction
description: Creates an area that enhances Guard and Evasion Recharge. The user's Cast Speed decreases and the effect ends when taking damage.

name: Magic UP
description: Increase MATK a little. The amount depends on the player's level.

name: Concentrate
description: Extremely low chance to increase  the last magic damage dealt.

name: Attack UP
description: Increase ATK a little. The amount depends on the player's level.

name: Whack
description: Extremely low chance to increase the last physical damage dealt.

name: Defense UP
description: Increase DEF and MDEF a little. The amount depends on the player's level.

name: Dodge UP
description: Increase Dodge Rate a little.

name: Desperate Resist
description: Reduce the damage taken while you are immobilized by the status ailments such as Stun and Tumble.

name: Critical UP
description: Increase Critical Rate and damage dealt a little.

name: Accuracy UP
description: Increase Accuracy Rate a little.

name: Increased Energy
description: Increase MATK a little. The amount depends on the player's level.

name: Intimidating Power
description: Increase ATK a litlle. The amount depends on the player's level.

name: Defense Mastery
description: Increase DEF & MDEF a little. The amount depends on the player's level.

name: Spell Burst
description: Critical ability slightly affects magic attack.

name: Secret Chase Attack
description: Increases the activation rate of additional melee and additional magic. Additional equipment required for this effect to apply.

name: Super Grip
description: Shortens the knockback distance when defeated.

name: Healing Song
description: A break for travelers. Increases EXP Gain and Natural Regen when not in combat. Grants additional HP and MP recovery when the battle ends, based on the battle duration. Cannot be sung at the same time with other songs.

name: Fairy Song
description: A fairy's guidance. Increase accuracy and dodge rate. Slightly restores MP ( based on the Attack MP Recovery value ) if the target successfully performs Evasion or Guard. Cannot be sung at the same time with other songs.

name: Passion Song
description: An incredibly strong and fierce determination. Increase damage to your weak element and to neutral-element targets. Increases Aggro when targeted. Cannot be sung at the same time with other songs.

name: Wisdom Song
description: Enlightenment born from immense knowledge. Reduces all types of damage and knockback distance. Cannot be sung at the same time with other songs.

name: Life Song
description: The beat of life. Reduces the revive timer at fixed intervals and stacks an effect that mitigates fractional damage. If HP hits 0, the accumulated value turns into a recovery barrier. Cannot be sung at the same time with other songs.

name: Fantasy Song
description: Feels like a dream, like an illusion. The song effect accumulates at fixed intervals. Restores MP with the effect when the skill ends. It won't activate during a combo. Cannot be sung at the same time with other songs.

name: Beat Blast
