description: A sound pressure attack that is only usable while a song skill is active. Gains stacks ( max 20 ) based on the MP consumed by party members affected by the song. Uses the stacks ( max 6 ) to deal magic damage to surrounding enemies (in combat).

name: Sound Veil
description: While a song skill is active, your aggro output becomes 1. Reduces all types of damage according to the number of acoustic buffs. However, damage from enemies aiming at you directly cannot be reduced.

name: Battle Anthem
description: While a song skill is active, emits an aggressive sound and performs a normal attack on targets within your weapon range if stationary. Activation interval depends on ASPD and skill level.

name: Ad-lib
description: Resumes the song skill used most recently. Reduces damage taken during Ad-lib if a song skill is ongoing. At Lv 10, it grants invincibility instead of damage reduction.

name: Fairy Dance
description: A graceful dance like a fairy. Reduce monster's accuracy. You can increase the effect by using it again right before the effect ends. The effect goes down if you reuse it too early or gain effect from another dance.

name: Frenzy Dance
description: An extremely emotional dance that makes it easier to break monster's parts. You can increase the effect by using it again right before the first effect ends. The effect goes down if you reuse it too early or gain effect from another dance.

name: Spirited Dance
description: A dance to cheer allies up. Immediately restores MP. You can increase the effect by using it again right before the first effect ends. The effect goes down if you reuse it too early or gain effect from another dance.

name: Astute Dance
description: An agile yet supple dance. Reduces monster's dodge rate. You can increase the effect by using it again right before the first effect ends. The effect goes down if you reuse it too early or gain effect from another dance.

name: Charming Dance
description: A fascinating dance that reduces monster's stability. You can increase the effect by using it again right before the first effect ends. The effect goes down if you reuse it too early or gain effect from another dance.

name: Elegant Poise
description: Handle attacks easily with a fan. Reduce damage received and becomes invincible while holding the fan. Can't hold the fan gracefully when inflicted with a status ailment.

name: Nature's Wonders
description: Attacks as if dancing beautifully. Deals damage to nearby enemies and recover nearby allies' HP when the skill ends. Depending on the skill level, you gain resistance to Flinch and Tumble.

name: Golem Call
description: Summons a golem to assist in battle. Your attacks won't restore MP. Instead, the golem's normal attacks will. From the EX skill, you can choose the golem type and adjust the magic lamp.

name: Neo Lancer
description: Improves the abilities of the Lancer-type golem. The golem's piercing power and Critical Rate increase, with a small boost also applied to the Shielder-type and Buster-type golem.

name: Attack Boost
description: Improves the magic lamp to increase attack efficiency. Increases the boost received per lamp power distributed to Attack. Always increases Accuracy, no matter the distribution.

name: Neo Shielder
description: Improves the abilities of the Shielder-type golem. The golem's active time and damage reduction range increase, with a small boost also applied to the Lancer-type and Buster-type golem.

name: Shield Boost
description: Improves the magic lamp to increase shield efficiency. Increases the boost received per lamp power distributed to Shield. Always increases damage reduction range, no matter the distribution.

name: Neo Buster
description: Improves the abilities of the Buster-type golem. The golem's piercing power and Critical Rate increase, with a small boost also applied to the Lancer-type and Shielder-type golem.

name: Speed Boost
description: Improves the magic lamp to increase speed. Increases Action Speed per lamp power distributed to Speed.

name: Magic Grenade
description: Destabilizes the magic lamp's power to use it like a bomb. It's an AoE attack, but it won't reach targets that are too far away. INT and TEC will boost its power further.

name: Frost Grenade
description: Fills the magic lamp with cold magic power. Its power depends on the Magic Grenade you've learned. May inflict [Freeze] on the target. If you get caught in the blast, there is a low chance of freezing yourself.

name: Flash Grenade
description: Fills the magic lamp with shining magic power. Its power depends on the Magic Grenade you've learned. May inflict [Dazzled] on the target. If you get caught in the blast, there is a medium chance to be dazzled too.

name: Barrier Screen
description: Deploys a drone that creates a magic barrier. Reduces the power of straight-line, bullet, or bowling blade-wave attacks that pass through the barrier, one time. *The power of certain attacks cannot be reduced. While deployed, Attack MP Recovery is reduced.

name: Barrier Upgrade
description: Improves the barrier drone. Boosts the barrier's damage reduction rate and lessens the decrease in Attack MP Recovery used to maintain the drone.

name: Refine Equipment
description: Refine equipment by yourself. The success rate is lower than the blacksmiths but you don't need Spina.

name: Novice's Anvil
description: Increases the proficiency limit of blacksmithing. Without this skill, proficiency can reach Lv50. At Lv10, the limit increases to the level cap.

name: Craftsman's Anvil
description: Reduces the materials required for Customize Equipment.

name: Blacksmith's Anvil
description: Reduces the materials required for Customize Equipment.

name: Master's Anvil
description: Reduces the materials required for Customize Equipment.

name: Master's Anvil II
description: Reduces the materials required for Customize Equipment.

name: Mid-Class Refinement
description: Increases the success rate of [Refine Equipment] a little.

name: High-Class Refinement
description: Increases the success rate of [Refine Equipment].

name: Expert's Refinement
description: Increases the success rate of [Refine Equipment] more.

name: Create Equipment
description: Create equipment by yourself. [Create Equipment] is required to attach stats.

name: Careful Creation
description: The potential of the equipment created by [Create equipment] increases.

name: Expert's Creation
description: The potential of the equipment created by [Create Equipment] increases.

name: Customize Equipment
description: Consume potential and attach stats to the equipment created by [Create Equipment].

name: Accurate Customization
description: The success rate of [Customize Equipment] increase a little. The number of abilities that you can add increase.

name: Expert's Customization
description: The number of abilities you can add with [Customize Equipment] increases.

name: Expert's Customization II
description: The ability in the first slot may remain unchanged even when Skill: [Customize Equipment] fails.

name: Process Materials
description: Process materials by yourself. The success rate increases as the skill levels up. It is a common skill in Smith and Alchemy Skills.

name: Metal Compassion
description: Reduces the Metal points consumed by Skill: [Customize Equipment].

name: Fabric Compassion
description: Reduces the Fabric points consumed by Skill: [Customize Equipment].

name: Beast Compassion
description: Reduces the Beast points consumed by Skill: [Customize Equipment].

name: Wood Compassion
description: Reduces the Wood points consumed by Skill: [Customize Equipment].

name: Medicine Compassion
description: Reduces the Medicine points consumed by Skill: [Customize Equipment].

name: Mana Compassion
description: Reduces the Mana points consumed by Skill: [Customize Equipment].

name: Item Synthesis
description: You can synthesize items by yourself. The success rate is lower than the synthesists but you don't need Spina.

name: Novice's Bottle
description: Increases the limit of synthesis proficiency level. You can level up the proficiency up to Lv50 without this skill.

name: Craftsman's Bottle
description: Increases the limit of proficiency level by 5 per skill level.

name: Synthesist's Bottle
description: Increases the limit of proficiency level by 5 per skill level.

name: Master's Bottle
description: Increases the limit of profiency level by 5 per skill level.

name: Master's Bottle II
description: Increases the limit of profiency level by 5 per skill level. Proficiency increases to the current level cap if all Bottle skills reach Lv10.

name: Mid-Class Synthesis
description: Increases the success rate of [Item Synthesist] a little.

name: High-Class Synthesis
description: Increases the success rate of [Item Synthesist].

name: Expert's Synthesis
description: Increases the success rate of [Item Synthesis] more.

name: Expert's Synthesis II
description: Moderately increases the success rates of Skill: [Item Synthesis].

name: Synthesize Equipment
description: You can synthesize items by yourself. The success rate is lower than synthesists but you don't need Spina.

name: Technical Synthesis I
description: Increases the success rates of Skill: [Synthesize Equipment] and enables the new EX Skill "Color Saving" .

name: Technical Synthesis II
description: Increases the success rates of Skill: [Synthesize Equipment].

name: Technical Synthesis III
description: Increases the success rates of Skill: [Synthesize Equipment].

name: Process Materials
description: Process materials by yourself. The success rate increases as the skill levels up. It is a common skill in Smith and Alchemy Skills.

name: Taming
description: Capture the monsters weaker than you. The Max Lv of them and time limit increase. The chance of breaking Cages decreases as the skill levels up. Consume [Cage] x1.

name: Capture Technique I
description: The Max Lv of the monsters that can be captured and time limit increase.

name: Capture Technique II
description: The Max Lv of the monsters that can be captured and time limit increase more.

name: Skillful Capture
description: Chance to raise the growth limit of the captured monsters.

name: Careful Capture
description: Chance to capture monsters with a little high Potential.

name: Pet Heal
description: Restore the called pet's HP. Unavailable on other players' pets.

name: Pet MP Charge
description: Restore the called pet's MP. Unavailable on other players' pets.

name: Kunai Throw
description: Attacks by throwing concealed kunai. Attacks repeatedly until you move and the attack will miss when it is out of range. Normal proration occurs when hitting the target and MP is slightly restored.

name: Fire Release
description: Deals magic damage based on MATK and may inflict [Ignite] on the target. If the conditions are met, it will be changed to an AOE attack with a higher power, and further additional attack that is not affected by combo will be activated.

name: Water Release
description: Creates a pool of water under you. Standing above the water lowers the damage from poison and ignite, as well as relieving the disadvantages from slow, stop, and freeze. If the conditions are met, it will be changed to a physical damage skill which depends on MATK.

name: Earth Release
description: Creates a shield with rocks and reduces long range damage received for certain times. When the effect ends, it will deal magic damage depending on MATK and the remaining number of protection.

name: Wind Release
description: Flies high while wrapped in the wind. Deals magic damage to nearby enemies based on MATK when landing. The skill direction changes according to the user's moving direction. Deals damage with either ATK or MATK depending on which is higher when it changes with katana. Gets an increased ASPD and critical rate for 20 seconds when active. Katana's power is further increased when it changes.

name: Demon Wind Shuriken
description: Throws gigantic shuriken. Deals damage within a narrow range and returns to the user after traveling a certain distance. When it hits a wall, the skill ends immediately.

name: Cloning
description: Attacks more frequently with a clone. Teleports to the clone's position and restore MP when Cloning is used again. MaxHP will be reduced while using the clone and you will be unable to control the clone if you are too far from it. If Shukuchi is learned, the clone will be accelerated by chance just once. If Decoy Shot is used, the clone will be replaced.

name: Thunder Release
description: Moves toward target quickly like a lightning and deals physical damage with either ATK or MATK depending on which is higher. Critical is guaranteed when used with katana.
